purpose: Pre-registered, measurable GO/NO-GO criteria of the S3 Data Feasibility Gate. Written and committed BEFORE the S3 audit was run on any data; thresholds are feasibility thresholds, not tuned to results.
scope: Binance Vision spot USDT pairs, development period only (months < 2025-07). The holdout period (>= 2025-07-01) is never requested, downloaded, parsed or inspected; survivorship uses only the S1 coverage table (existence metadata, accepted in S1).
universe_rule: S1 rule: USDT pair, base not stablecoin/fiat/leveraged token; eligible at date T if >= 60 daily candles in the 90 days before T and median daily quote volume over those days >= threshold; only data strictly before T.
regime_rule: Descriptive labels for coverage only, from BTCUSDT daily closes, evaluated at each month start using the trailing 180 days: return >= +30 % bull, <= -20 % bear, otherwise sideways. Not used for selection of anything.

sampling.stratification: uniform random over (symbol, month) pairs with >= 1 USDT-pair 1h file, stratified by calendar year, dev period only

criteria.name: licence read from primary source and intended use permitted
criteria.rule: primary text read AND historical backtesting for personal non-production research explicitly permitted

criteria.name: paper/live trading with derived signals
criteria.rule: reported as NOT permitted or NOT covered; any such use requires a separate licence decision

criteria.name: file integrity
criteria.rule: share of downloaded dev-period files whose sha256 equals the published .CHECKSUM >= 0.999

criteria.name: daily data quality
criteria.rule: share of dev-period symbol-month daily files quarantined (fatal defect) <= 0.02

criteria.name: hourly data quality sample
criteria.rule: upper 95 % Wilson bound of the fatal-defect rate in the stratified hourly sample <= 0.10; all defect classes detected by synthetic tests

criteria.name: universe depth at 1 M USDT
criteria.rule: >= 30 PIT-eligible assets at 100 % of month starts 2021-01..2025-06

criteria.name: universe depth at 5 M USDT
criteria.rule: >= 30 PIT-eligible assets at >= 80 % of month starts 2021-01..2025-06

criteria.name: depth after identity exclusions
criteria.rule: U1 still holds after removing every symbol flagged by an identity rule (coverage break >= 2 months, or close-to-open daily jump >= 10x or <= 0.1x, or a month with ticker-reuse flag)

criteria.name: survivorship
criteria.rule: delisted symbols retained: every symbol with last_month < 2026-10 has dev-period files that were downloaded and checked (share = 1.0 of those with dev data)

criteria.name: survivorship measured
criteria.rule: share of PIT-eligible assets (1 M) that are delisted by 2026-10 reported per cohort date; informational, must be reported

criteria.name: regime coverage
criteria.rule: each regime label has >= 6 month starts with >= 30 eligible assets at 1 M

criteria.name: reproducibility
criteria.rule: two independent analysis runs on the pinned manifest give identical output hash; every file pinned by sha256

criteria.name: resources
criteria.rule: estimated storage for 1h klines of the 1 M eligible universe <= 2 GB zipped and one-off download <= 3 h at measured throughput; analysis single core

criteria.name: time dimension
criteria.rule: reported: calendar years with >= 30 eligible assets, number of distinct regime episodes; informational limitation, not a gate

decision.GO: all gates pass without exclusion beyond what the criteria define
decision.CONDITIONAL_GO: all gates pass but only after documented exclusions/quarantine (identity flags, defective files); a later dataset builder must implement them
